Monthly Subset

month_start <- "2026-05-01"

make_week_index <- function(df){

  start_month <- as.POSIXct(
    format(min(df$TIMESTAMP),
           "%Y-%m-01 00:00"),
    tz = "UTC"
  )

  df$week_in_month <- floor(
    as.numeric(
      difftime(
        df$TIMESTAMP,
        start_month,
        units = "days"
      )
    ) / 7
  ) + 1

  df
}

df_month <- subset(
  df,
  TIMESTAMP >= as.POSIXct(
    month_start,
    tz = "UTC"
  )
)

df_month <- make_week_index(df_month)

Functions

break_gaps <- function(
  df,
  ts_col,
  value_col,
  max_gap_minutes = 90
){

  df <- df[order(df[[ts_col]]), ]

  dt <- as.numeric(
    difftime(
      df[[ts_col]],
      dplyr::lag(df[[ts_col]]),
      units = "mins"
    )
  )

  gap <- dt > max_gap_minutes
  gap[is.na(gap)] <- FALSE

  df[[value_col]][gap] <- NA

  df
}
plot_met_single <- function(
  df,
  variable,
  ylab,
  title,
  color = "blue"
){

  df <- break_gaps(
    df,
    "TIMESTAMP",
    variable
  )

  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      TIMESTAMP,
      .data[[variable]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = color
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ylab,
      title = title
    )
}
plot_met_long <- function(
  df,
  cols,
  labels,
  colors,
  ylab,
  title
){

  dfl <- pivot_longer(
    df,
    all_of(cols),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

  dfl$variable <- factor(
    dfl$variable,
    levels = cols,
    labels = labels
  )

  ggplot(
    dfl,
    aes(
      TIMESTAMP,
      value,
      color = variable
    )
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = colors
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ylab,
      title = title,
      color = NULL
    )
}

Create potential radiation dataset

mindate <- min(df$TIMESTAMP, na.rm = TRUE)
maxdate <- max(df$TIMESTAMP, na.rm = TRUE)

TIMESTAMP <- seq(
  from = mindate,
  to = maxdate,
  by = "30 min"
)

JD <- as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%j"))
h  <- as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%H"))
m  <- as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%M"))

H <- h + ifelse(m == 30, 0.5, 0)

rpot_vals <- potential.radiation(doy = JD,hour = H,latDeg = 68.5272,longDeg = -149.5491,timezone = -9,useSolartime = T)*1.1

rpot_df <- data.frame(
  TIMESTAMP = TIMESTAMP,
  rpot = as.numeric(rpot_vals)
)

df <- merge(
  df,
  rpot_df,
  by = "TIMESTAMP",
  all.x = TRUE
)

stopifnot("rpot" %in% names(df))
